purpose: Canonical semantic color tokens for Nexo Group UI. New components must use semantic tokens instead of arbitrary text/surface colors.

governance.rule1: Day and night themes must define the same semantic token names.
governance.rule2: Text on dark surfaces must use night text tokens; text on light surfaces must use day text tokens.
governance.rule3: Gold is primarily a night-mode emphasis color. Day mode uses Nexo blue/green/orange.
governance.rule4: Role badges, quick settings, modals, overlays, tabs, buttons and future architecture changes must consume these semantic tokens.
governance.rule5: Do not introduce new literal text/surface colors without first updating this token file and docs/NEXO_VISUAL_SYSTEM.md.
